Name: Gender Neutral Social Tab
Author: Suntooth
Description:
Changes gendered words for partners to gender neutral ones in the social tab. Namely:
[list]
[*]"husband" and "wife" are changed to "spouse", "married", or "partner"

[*]"boyfriend" and "girlfriend" are changed to "partner" or "dating"

[*]"ex-husband" and "ex-wife" are changed to "ex-spouse", "ex-married", or "ex-partner"

[/list]No changes are made to dialogue or anything else - this only affects the social tab. Fully customisable via a config file or GMCM.

Downloads.Description: The mod broke sometime in the past two years. It now works again, but should still work on old versions of the game.
